findings.detail: The PLAYER_DEPTH/set-piece depth-clamping and carried/melee weapon rendering changes are unrelated to the cleared-arena stall and have no dependency on its safe-room, purge, or farm-window fixes. They add a separate rendering behavior change and tests to a declared 3-apple AI/scenario fix, increasing regression surface and obscuring causal review. Remove these rendering changes from this diff and submit them as a separately scoped change.

independent_grade.notes: The safe-room discriminator now correctly excludes converted arenas from the Floor 2 authored-safe-room fact, and the purge, bounded farm window, deterministic headless regression, and targeted unit coverage substantiate the stated stall fix. However, the independent player/weapon render-depth feature makes the diff non-surgical for the declared task, so scope discipline is below the passing threshold.
